reference_sql:
WITH costed AS (  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, category_id, unit_cost_eur,
         AVG(unit_cost_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id) AS avg_cost
  FROM products
)
SELECT product_id, category_id, unit_cost_eur, ROUND(avg_cost, 2) AS category_avg_cost
FROM costed
WHERE unit_cost_eur > avg_cost
alternatives:
WITH category_avg AS (  -- one row per category
  SELECT category_id, AVG(unit_cost_eur) AS avg_cost
  FROM products
  GROUP BY category_id
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.unit_cost_eur, ROUND(ca.avg_cost, 2) AS category_avg_cost
FROM products p
JOIN category_avg ca ON ca.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE p.unit_cost_eur > ca.avg_cost

SELECT t.product_id, t.category_id, t.unit_cost_eur, ROUND(t.avg_cost, 2) AS category_avg_cost
FROM (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, category_id, unit_cost_eur,
         AVG(unit_cost_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id) AS avg_cost
  FROM products
) AS t
WHERE t.unit_cost_eur > t.avg_cost

other_way.tradeoff: Joining a per-category average step needs no window, but it is a second step and a join for one comparison.
